result.title: AgroVG+: Generalized Visual Grounding in Agriculture with Region-Supervised Action Generation
result.summary: Generalized visual grounding in agriculture requires localizing all objects that match a natural-language description and recognizing when no matching target is present. We introduce AgroVG+, a dataset whose referring expressions are all written and reviewed by agricultural experts based on image content and corresponding target sets. The dataset comprises 7,404 images and 10,081 query records across six agricultural scene families, covering single-target, multi-target, and target-absent cases. We also propose ReSAG (Region-Supervised Action Generation), a framework that couples regional evidence supervision with explicit box-generation and termination decisions. ReSAG assigns each target an equally weighted supervision term on a shared spatial evidence distribution computed before answer generation. The BOX/END protocol exposes a choice between generating another box and terminating the response at box boundaries, while coordinates are generated using the original language vocabulary. Regional and sequence objectives jointly train a shared language decoder. On AgroVG+, ReSAG outperforms coordinate-only fine-tuning on single- and multi-target exact-set accuracy, and achieves higher aggregate accuracy than either component alone in ablations.

AI.brief_summary: 构建农艺场景的广义视觉接地数据集 AgroVG+（7,404 张图、含单目标、多目标与无目标查询），并提出 ReSAG 框架：在生成答案前计算共享空间证据分布并对各目标等权监督，用 BOX/END 协议显式决定继续出框还是终止，坐标仍走原词表生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 BOX/END 终止动作与逐目标等权证据监督，可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 决策与多证据贡献分配的设计线索；但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态，联系属方法借鉴层面的推测。
